method: Diffed omp_home.py (609 lines, sha a934a66b...), cli.py, launcher.py, omp-isolation.yml; compared user_omp_locations with the OMP 18.4.5 binary dirs.ts (KK/$ct/NMo/edt/Xge) read as source text; checked binary for handoff-variable semantics; no credential/environ reads.

checks.cmd: unittest test_omp_home, p27u, p27v, test_omp_isolation, p27m, p27n, ui p27p (TMPDIR=/tmp/rv02-*, removed)

findings.summary: F3's refuse-on-unresolvable-env (relative PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, invalid OMP_PROFILE, relative XDG_DATA_HOME) is evaluated before the running-backend check, so even attaching to an already running backend via 'start' is refused for an env that only matters for a new start.
findings.fix: Run omp_home_location only when no backend is running (move after _running_snapshot) or catch the unresolvable case for attach.

findings.summary: OMP_WORKTREE_DIR / OMP_*_CACHE_DB / OMP_AUTH_BROKER_SNAPSHOT_CACHE are user-tunable locations, not handoff vars; dropping them moves worker worktrees/caches into the Workbench home (intended by C-D64) but is a user-visible behaviour change not mentioned in the yml/status note.
findings.fix: One doc/note line; no code change required.

verdicts.F1: closed. The four named vars plus the audited handoff/cache vars are dropped and flagged as env:<KEY> leaks. Dropped vars are OMP internal handoff (PI_SESSION_FILE, PI_ARTIFACTS_DIR, PI_TOOL_BRIDGE_*, PI_EVAL_LOCAL_ROOTS, *_SOCKET, DAEMON/LSP_MUX dirs, IDA/BLOB broker config: confirmed in the binary as values OMP sets for its children) or state-location overrides. PATH/LANG/TERM/provider keys/OMP_AUTH_BROKER_URL/_TOKEN/_ACCOUNT_POOL_FILE are kept; none of the dropped names is needed for normal operation (N2 note only).
verdicts.browser: ok. browser.enabled=false in omp-isolation.yml (--config, beats project config) and in the home config.yml; leak detection (dumpTools name 'browser', xd://eval/browser in tool description or prompt) is unit-tested and the live run shows 0 leaks; other tools untouched; ~/.omp/browser-state not created.
verdicts.F2: resolved by turning the browser off (user decision 2026-10-03), no residual write path left except natives (adjudicated).
verdicts.F3: closed. user_omp_locations mirrors the binary: OMP_PROFILE ?? PI_PROFILE with ''/'default' = none, invalid = refused, profile ignores PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, a stale-profile agent dir override is ignored, absolute override replaces <root>/agent, XDG data only for the default agent dir, relative values refused naming the variable. Refusals create nothing (omp_home_location runs before _layout(create=False)); the user's values travel only as WORKBENCH_USER_* in the check env and are stripped before Popen. Fixture adjudication (profile-fixture) is consistent: complementary refusal case added. Only N1 (P3).
verdicts.F4: closed. No store + non-empty provider key var starts without creating/keeping a link (existing link removed); notes carry variable names only, never values; store with other states (symlink, directory, foreign owner) still refused. Local wb agent.db created by OMP is moved aside when a store appears.
verdicts.F5: closed by documentation plus a per-start isolation note (XDG_BASH_NOTE).
verdicts.tests: adaptations keep the invariants (profile/redirect env never reaches OMP, wb home used, refusal creates nothing, check env == pane env for home keys); new p27v tests exercise real prepare/launch/check paths rather than mocks.

overall_reason: No P0/P1/P2. F1-F5 and the browser decision are fixed and tested; two P3 notes only.
